description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendDateProposal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveDateResponses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineAvailableFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DateDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRequestedGames</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GamesAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DownloadMissingGames</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineBeerRequired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnjoyParty</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Party</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Plan LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive the friends' list of requested games"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Find a date and check requested games"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDateProposal" name="Send the proposed date to the friends"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" name="Receive friends' responses to the proposed date"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineAvailableFriends" name="Determine how many friends are free to join"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateDecision" name="Do at least 8 friends agree on the date?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequestedGames" name="Check whether all requested games are available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesAvailable" name="Are all requested games available?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadMissingGames" name="Download missing games"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Requested games ready"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineBeerRequired" name="Find out how much beer the friends will require"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerDecision" name="Is there enough beer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyMissingBeer" name="Buy the missing beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Beer ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Party" name="LAN party enjoyed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Invitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_Plan" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_GameList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameList_Split" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Date" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Date_SendProposal" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_SendDateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendProposal_Responses" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Responses_DetermineAvailable" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" targetRef="Task_DetermineAvailableFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineAvailable_DateDecision" sourceRef="Task_DetermineAvailableFriends" targetRef="Gateway_DateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAccepted" name="At least 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">attendingCount >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateRetry" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Task_AppointDate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">attendingCount < 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRequestedGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_Availability" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequestedGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable" name="All requested games are available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allRequestedGamesAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Some requested games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Task_DownloadMissingGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">someRequestedGamesMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Download_GamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadMissingGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_Beer" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_DetermineBeerRequired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Beer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_DetermineBeerRequired" targetRef="Gateway_BeerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableBeer >= requiredBeer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Task_BuyMissingBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableBeer < requiredBeer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyMissingBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enjoy_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_Party"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organizer" name="Organizer" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitations" name="Invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="List of requested games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Proposed date" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateResponses" name="Responses to proposed date" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
